entries.subject: DAMIT 403: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-403.txt. Model 403, version 2011-04-21, pole (12°, -73°), period 9.78693 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 29.179 ±0.155 km. The thermal effective spherical diameter is used as an approximate volume-equivalent display scale; no joint shape/thermal inversion or independently measured volume is implied.,Quoted ±0.155 km is the catalog fit error; approximately 10% additional systematic diameter uncertainty applies.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT matches
entries.finding: [Other DAMIT matches](https://damit.cuni.cz/?q=1140) — Inspected for calibrated replacements; retain the selected solution and disclose available alternatives. The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 404: pole (175°, -22°), 9.78694 h, version 2011-04-21. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A model-specific comparison establishes whether an archived alternative improves the selected shape or resolves its pole/scale ambiguity.
